Aberdeen drinks the River Dee 💧
Scottish Water takes water from the Dee at Cairnton and treats it at Invercannie, which Queen Victoria opened on 16 October 1866. Today it serves around 300,000 customers across the North East and can make up to 63 million litres of drinking water a day. An upgrade added a 19 million litre storage tank.
